method: Whole preprocess.c/h read; Git blob verification, static analysis.
findings: Same-file sorting uses observed size, device, inode, parent inode and basename before removing adjacent repeats. No fresh metadata lookup is explicitly requested by these comparisons; lazy parent lookup behavior was reviewed separately.
Hardlink sorting uses observed size/device/inode and rank. Equal aliases are bundled or discarded according to find_hardlinked_dupes; this is identity-based grouping rather than content equality.

Path repeats removed before nonduplicate-lint filtering, then hardlinks bundled and remaining files sorted into candidate groups by rank_group. Candidate grouping constraints depend on rank implementation still unread.

Other-lint output applies configured mtime/protection rules, sorts empty directories reverse alphabetically and forwards records without a fresh filesystem check in this module. It generates output records, not direct deletion here.
Source comment claims sort-based handling30percent faster than hashtable; no benchmark evidence collected, so this is not an accepted optimization for rrrah.

File-table destruction frees all_files queue container without unref of elements in that branch; normal preprocess drains it, but early lifecycle ownership needs inspection before leak claim. Header clear-function declaration has no definition in this implementation file.
limits: No original tests/runtime or own-library source edits.
Rank/traverse/session lifecycle remain unreviewed. Native pHash deferred; global full repository count150/500.
